placements.title: Lasting value shifts from the producing substrate to the perspective a person keeps
placements.frame: Where does the durable value of intelligence sit in a given account: in the substrate that produces it, or in the perspective the holder retains, and what would change if the substrate were replaced?
placements.why: Both expressions carry one thematic claim: intelligence is durable when owned in the sense of the perspective kept, and the underlying substrate is interchangeable. This is a subject future envelopes can keep feeding (ownership versus rental of intelligence), not a fact or measurement. No existing leaf, strata, or structure is supplied, so nothing can be reused, and no hub or strata category is clearly warranted by this single standalone leaf.
consulted: STRATA REFERENCE: no coordinate maps an organizational category this content names
